handler.description: Present only on allow. Identifies the chosen handler component.

portal_grant_digests.description: Portal grants minted as part of routing (file picks, bookmark claims, etc.).

consent_digest.description: Optional digest of a consent receipt if interactive choice occurred.

target_role.description: Trusted host-managed target role used for routing, such as browsing or communications.

resolution_mode.description: How the target was selected within the trusted routing boundary.

role_binding_digest.description: Digest of the trusted remembered role-binding snapshot used for target selection.

import_receipt_digest.description: Optional digest of the exact content.import.receipt that produced the imported artifact being opened across compartments. Used for file open/view/edit routes so routing evidence can point back to safe-open / provenance intake evidence.

working_copy_receipt_digest.description: Optional digest of the exact content.working-copy.receipt that created the writable working copy being routed to `document_editing`. Used to prove the edit route opened an explicit working copy rather than the imported original.
